title: EncryVia Website
description: A modern, responsive corporate website built with React and Tailwind CSS. Features include dynamic animations, contact forms, service showcases, and optimized performance. The site includes advanced SEO optimization and secure contact handling.

title: Network Security Management Dashboard
description: A unified platform that combines network monitoring with real-time security intelligence for IT administrators. Delivers continuous network health visibility, automated threat detection and blocking, proactive vulnerability identification, and 99.9% uptime reliability. Generates compliance-ready reports while reducing operational complexity through integrated diagnostics and security management in a single solution.

title: Audbaba E-commerce Platform
description: AudBaba is a comprehensive multi-vendor marketplace platform designed to connect businesses with professional service providers. Built on WordPress with WooCommerce and Dokan integration, this project delivers a scalable B2B marketplace solution.

title: DriveLite - Privacy-First Cloud Storage Platform
description: DriveLite is a fast, minimalist, and privacy-focused file storage application designed for developers and privacy-conscious users. Positioned as (The Suparbase for File Storage) it combines enterprise-grade security with developer-friendly APIs and self-hosting capabilities.

title: AI-Powered SEO Analytics Dashboard
description: Advanced SEO analytics platform with AI-driven insights, keyword tracking, competitor analysis, and automated reporting. Integrates with Google Analytics, Search Console, and social media APIs.
